title: EndpointComplianceProbeResponse
description: 200 response body for POST /v1/probe after settle. Challenge-observation fields only (not full client payment loop).

returns_402.description: True if the target responded with HTTP 402 when challenged (pre-settle observation).

signaling_shape.description: Observed payment-challenge signaling shape on the 402 (challenge only; not SIGNATURE/RESPONSE).

network.description: As-observed from challenge when present; prefer CAIP-2 (e.g. eip155:8453). Do not normalize chain nicknames. Null if absent.

asset.description: As-observed from challenge when present (address or CAIP-19 string). Null if absent.

pass.description: True if the target meets the probe compliance criteria. Clients derive fail as !pass.

target_url.description: Optional echo of buyer-submitted URL (request field targetUrl).

observed_status.description: HTTP status observed from the target during the challenge phase.

raw_challenge_fields.description: Optional non-secret subset of challenge fields. MUST NOT include secrets, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, Authorization credentials, payment payloads, private keys, or settlement proofs.

truncated.description: Optional. True if the probe response body was truncated (aligns CISO egress controls).

abort_reason.description: Optional. Egress/policy abort code only when the probe aborted; null if completed. No secrets.
